card.name: Nouns after 'other', 'one', 'similar'
card.fires_on: Generic nouns such as year, years, situation, matches, maintenance right after a vague qualifier like one, other, similar, or routine. The setting is general web prose.

modes.label: Time nouns after one/other
modes.description: The word year or years after a vague opener such as One or In other.
modes.example: In other<< years>>, they are absent.

modes.label: Situation-type nouns
modes.description: A general noun such as situation, matches or maintenance that closes a phrase describing a kind of case.
modes.example: might be educated on how to manage a similar<< situation>>.
